fetched_title: Best of mini-N in-loop Sampling: A Contextual Quality Reward Model for Reliable and Efficient Best-of-N Sampling
summary: Adds a discrete-choice outside option to a reward model so it can reject all candidates, then samples adaptively; it reports that reliability failures in the best-of-N baseline more than double from N=1 to N=32. This is a reward-model training method, not a comparison of an LLM judge on pools versus alone.
